definition.en: The eye runs top-start to top-end, diagonally down, then along the bottom: text and media alternate across a split, the action at the end.
definition.fr: Le regard va du début du haut à la fin du haut, descend en diagonale, puis longe le bas : texte et média alternent de part et d’autre d’un partage, l’action à la fin.
definition.de: Der Blick läuft oben vom Anfang zum Ende, diagonal nach unten, dann am unteren Rand entlang: Text und Medien wechseln sich über eine Teilung ab, die Aktion am Ende.
definition.es: La mirada va del inicio al final de la parte superior, baja en diagonal y luego recorre la parte inferior: texto y medios se alternan a ambos lados de una división, la acción al final.
definition.ru: Взгляд идёт по верху от начала к концу, по диагонали вниз, затем вдоль низа: текст и медиа чередуются по обе стороны деления, действие в конце.

definition.en: The eye scans the top line, a shorter second line, then down the start edge: a reading column or a list of rows.
definition.fr: Le regard parcourt la ligne du haut, une deuxième ligne plus courte, puis descend le long du bord de début : une colonne de lecture ou une liste de rangées.
definition.de: Der Blick überfliegt die oberste Zeile, eine kürzere zweite Zeile, dann den Anfangsrand hinab: eine Lesespalte oder eine Liste von Zeilen.
definition.es: La mirada recorre la línea superior, una segunda línea más corta y luego baja por el borde de inicio: una columna de lectura o una lista de filas.
definition.ru: Взгляд пробегает верхнюю строку, более короткую вторую, затем идёт вниз вдоль начального края: колонка для чтения или список строк.

definition.en: The section is one grid of equal modules in three or more columns.
definition.fr: La section est une seule grille de modules égaux sur trois colonnes ou plus.
definition.de: Der Abschnitt ist ein einziges Raster gleicher Module in drei oder mehr Spalten.
definition.es: La sección es una sola retícula de módulos iguales en tres o más columnas.
definition.ru: Секция — одна сетка из равных модулей в три колонки и больше.

definition.en: The page canon of Van de Graaf: one text block in a 2:3 page with margins 1:1:2:3 (inner, top, outer, bottom), a reading measure centred above the middle.
definition.fr: Le canon de page de Van de Graaf : un seul bloc de texte dans une page 2:3 aux marges 1:1:2:3 (intérieure, haut, extérieure, bas), une mesure de lecture centrée au-dessus du milieu.
definition.de: Der Seitenkanon von Van de Graaf: ein Textblock auf einer 2:3-Seite mit Rändern 1:1:2:3 (innen, oben, außen, unten), ein Lesemaß zentriert über der Mitte.
definition.es: El canon de página de Van de Graaf: un solo bloque de texto en una página 2:3 con márgenes 1:1:2:3 (interior, superior, exterior, inferior), una medida de lectura centrada por encima del medio.
definition.ru: Канон страницы Ван де Граафа: один текстовый блок на странице 2:3 с полями 1:1:2:3 (внутреннее, верхнее, внешнее, нижнее), ширина строки по центру выше середины.

definition.en: Main masses sit on a 1/3 : 2/3 split or on thirds lines.
definition.fr: Les masses principales reposent sur un partage 1/3 : 2/3 ou sur les lignes des tiers.
definition.de: Die Hauptmassen liegen auf einer Teilung 1/3 : 2/3 oder auf den Drittellinien.
definition.es: Las masas principales se sitúan en una división 1/3 : 2/3 o sobre las líneas de los tercios.
definition.ru: Главные массы стоят на делении 1/3 : 2/3 или на линиях третей.

definition.en: One dominant mass (card, headline, figure) in open space, usually near the centre.
definition.fr: Une masse dominante (carte, titre, figure) dans un espace ouvert, généralement près du centre.
definition.de: Eine dominante Masse (Karte, Überschrift, Abbildung) im freien Raum, meist nahe der Mitte.
definition.es: Una masa dominante (tarjeta, titular, figura) en un espacio abierto, normalmente cerca del centro.
definition.ru: Одна доминирующая масса (карточка, заголовок, фигура) в свободном пространстве, обычно ближе к центру.

definition.en: Heavy elements along two edges forming an L: a side or top band plus a bottom or start band.
definition.fr: Des éléments lourds le long de deux bords forment un L : une bande latérale ou haute plus une bande basse ou de début.
definition.de: Schwere Elemente entlang zweier Ränder bilden ein L: ein seitliches oder oberes Band plus ein unteres oder Anfangsband.
definition.es: Elementos pesados a lo largo de dos bordes forman una L: una banda lateral o superior más una banda inferior o de inicio.
definition.ru: Тяжёлые элементы вдоль двух краёв образуют L: боковая или верхняя полоса плюс нижняя или начальная.

definition.en: A narrow apex over a wide base: a short headline over a wider row of cards or tiles.
definition.fr: Un sommet étroit sur une base large : un titre court au-dessus d’une rangée plus large de cartes ou de tuiles.
definition.de: Eine schmale Spitze über einer breiten Basis: eine kurze Überschrift über einer breiteren Reihe von Karten oder Kacheln.
definition.es: Un vértice estrecho sobre una base ancha: un titular corto sobre una fila más ancha de tarjetas o mosaicos.
definition.ru: Узкая вершина над широким основанием: короткий заголовок над более широким рядом карточек или плиток.

definition.en: The weight runs along a diagonal: tilted bands, a staircase of cards.
definition.fr: Le poids suit une diagonale : bandes inclinées, escalier de cartes.
definition.de: Das Gewicht verläuft entlang einer Diagonale: geneigte Bänder, eine Treppe aus Karten.
definition.es: El peso sigue una diagonal: bandas inclinadas, una escalera de tarjetas.
definition.ru: Вес идёт по диагонали: наклонные полосы, лесенка из карточек.

definition.en: Elements radiate from a point: sunburst, rays, concentric rings.
definition.fr: Les éléments rayonnent depuis un point : soleil, rayons, anneaux concentriques.
definition.de: Die Elemente strahlen von einem Punkt aus: Strahlenkranz, Strahlen, konzentrische Ringe.
definition.es: Los elementos irradian desde un punto: resplandor, rayos, anillos concéntricos.
definition.ru: Элементы расходятся из точки: солнечные лучи, лучи, концентрические кольца.

definition.en: A circle holds or frames the content, or circles are the main motif.
definition.fr: Un cercle contient ou encadre le contenu, ou les cercles sont le motif principal.
definition.de: Ein Kreis hält oder rahmt den Inhalt, oder Kreise sind das Hauptmotiv.
definition.es: Un círculo contiene o enmarca el contenido, o los círculos son el motivo principal.
definition.ru: Круг вмещает или обрамляет содержимое, либо круги — главный мотив.

definition.en: Content on the vertical and horizontal axes around a centre.
definition.fr: Le contenu sur les axes vertical et horizontal autour d’un centre.
definition.de: Inhalt auf der senkrechten und der waagerechten Achse um eine Mitte.
definition.es: Contenido en los ejes vertical y horizontal alrededor de un centro.
definition.ru: Содержимое на вертикальной и горизонтальной осях вокруг центра.

definition.en: Two arms converging on a point.
definition.fr: Deux branches convergent vers un point.
definition.de: Zwei Arme laufen auf einen Punkt zu.
definition.es: Dos brazos que convergen en un punto.

cart-drawer.title: Cart Drawer

category-nav.title: Category Nav
category-nav.description: Categories as chips, a bar, a side list, tiles, or chips under a toolbar.

chart-panel.title: Chart Panel

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.description: Tasks to finish after sign-up, with progress.

checkout-form.title: Checkout Form
checkout-form.description: Contacts, address, a window and the payment beside a sticky order summary.

combo-builder.title: Combo Builder

comparison-table.title: Comparison Table

compose.title: Compose
compose.description: Barrel of the composed primitives (compose/index), imported by components and blocks

contact-form.title: Contact Form

cookie-banner.title: Cookie Banner
cookie-banner.description: A consent notice with accept and decline buttons.

credit-packs.title: Credit Packs
credit-packs.description: One-off packs of credits with a price: tiles in two or four columns, or rows.

cta-proof.title: Cta Proof
cta-proof.description: A call to action with logos, features, figures, icon rows or delivery zones; centered or beside a picture.

dashboard-overview.title: Dashboard Overview
dashboard-overview.description: Counters, a chart and recent activity in one section.

dashboard-shell.title: Dashboard Shell
dashboard-shell.description: Twelve frames of a signed-in app around empty cards: a top bar across the shell or over the content, with or without search; a wide, rail, collapsed, two-level or no sidebar, at the start or the end; a footer across the shell, under the content or none.

delivery-info.title: Delivery Info
delivery-info.description: How delivery works: the facts, then the zones.

dish-bento.title: Dish Bento
dish-bento.description: One featured dish in a large tile among smaller ones.

dish-card.title: Dish Card
dish-card.description: A dish as a card: picture, category, portion/weight, price and an order button. No rating.

dish-cart-grid.title: Dish Cart Grid
dish-cart-grid.description: Cards with a quantity field and an add button, under a live cart count.

dish-compare.title: Dish Compare
dish-compare.description: Grill cuts side by side: a table or compare cards.

dish-showcase.title: Dish Showcase
dish-showcase.description: Dish cards that each open the dish page; no cart.

dish-strip.title: Dish Strip
dish-strip.description: A horizontal strip of small cards that scrolls sideways.

empty-panel.title: Empty Panel
empty-panel.description: A list with nothing in it, with an optional action.

error-page.title: Error Page
error-page.description: A page for something that went wrong, such as a missing page: a code, a heading, a sentence and the way back.

faq-split.title: Faq Split
faq-split.description: Questions beside the heading, a help card, a picture or a finder, or as cards in three or four columns.

feature-accordion.title: Feature Accordion
feature-accordion.description: Features as a list of disclosures, the first one open, with an optional picture.

feature-grid.title: Feature Grid
feature-grid.description: Features as cards, tiles or rows with a picture.

feature-showcase.title: Feature Showcase
feature-showcase.description: Cards with a picture on top and a read link, or with a muted glyph panel on top like an index of categories, in three or four columns.

feature-split.title: Feature Split
feature-split.description: Features beside a picture: plain in two columns, as cards with actions, two figures over checked rows, or four metric cards with actions.

feature-sticky.title: Feature Sticky
feature-sticky.description: A picture that stays in view beside a list of features. Following the section being read is a port contract (ScrollSpy).

feature-tabs.title: Feature Tabs
feature-tabs.description: Features as tabs; the chosen one fills the panel beside or below the tab list.

footer-split.title: Footer Split
footer-split.description: The brand with figures and a sitemap link over link-group cards; or a split beside a picture with points, link columns, a newsletter card, the contacts or the community channels.

grill-builder.title: Grill Builder
grill-builder.description: Choose the meat, the weight and the sides of a grill (mangal) dish.

grocery-list.title: Grocery List
grocery-list.description: A compact list of groceries with a small picture and an add button.

hero-classic.title: Hero Classic
hero-classic.description: Heading, lead, one or two actions and optional media.

hero-prompt.title: Hero Prompt
hero-prompt.description: Heading, lead, one or two actions and optional media.

hero-split.title: Hero Split
hero-split.description: A split hero with figures, faces, small cards or a quote under the lead, beside a picture, a floating card, a picture grid or plan cards.

icon-wall.title: Icon Wall
icon-wall.description: Many small features as icons with a name: tiles or chips in three to six columns.

job-board.title: Job Board
job-board.description: Open jobs as cards, grouped by department, or as a table.

kanban-board.title: Kanban Board
kanban-board.description: Work items in lanes with a count; cards with a tag and a person. Moving cards is a port contract (SortableList).

lightbox-gallery.title: Lightbox Gallery
lightbox-gallery.description: A photo gallery with a dialog for the selected picture. Additive to Photo gallery.

logo-cloud.title: Logo Cloud
logo-cloud.description: Customers and partners as glyphs with names.

media-list.title: Media List
media-list.description: Four figures, figures with a featured review, numbered steps, the latest posts, topic rows, or contact buttons with support figures, beside a picture.

mega-menu.title: Mega Menu
mega-menu.description: A top bar whose first item opens a wide panel of link groups, with an optional promo card.

menu-board.title: Menu Board
menu-board.description: Category sections with DishCards in a grid, or denser menu rows; prices can be hidden.

milestone-timeline.title: Milestone Timeline
milestone-timeline.description: Milestones on a vertical line beside a picture, in a narrow column, or in a row.

nav-bar.title: Nav Bar
nav-bar.description: A top bar in four shapes: inline, split around the brand, with a search field, and transparent over a picture.

newsletter-form.title: Newsletter Form
newsletter-form.description: An email field and a button, inline, stacked or beside a picture.

order-summary.title: Order Summary
order-summary.description: Subtotal, shipping, tax and the total.

page-intro.title: Page Intro
page-intro.description: The head of an inner page: the heading, one sentence and an optional action.

page-trail.title: Page Trail
page-trail.description: Breadcrumbs over the badge, the heading and the lead; with one large figure, a note card or four key facts at the end.

photo-gallery.title: Photo Gallery
photo-gallery.description: Photos in a grid, a masonry, a mosaic, a featured picture with thumbnails, or cards.

pizza-picker.title: Pizza Picker
pizza-picker.description: Pizza cards with a size and a crust radio group and an add button.

post-grid.title: Post Grid
post-grid.description: Posts as a grid, a list or a magazine.

post-header.title: Post Header
post-header.description: Category, title, excerpt, author line and a wide cover.

post-showcase.title: Post Showcase
post-showcase.description: Four small post cards beside an intro with a view-all link; the first post in detail beside its picture; or cards with the text on a panel over the picture, in two or three columns.

post-split.title: Post Split
post-split.description: Tags, reading figures and an author card with share and save over a wide cover; the author, figures, tags and actions beside the cover; or the facts and related reading beside it.

pricing-tiers.title: Pricing Tiers
pricing-tiers.description: Plans as a grid or a stack of cards.

product-detail.title: Product Detail
product-detail.description: The gallery and the buy box of one product.

product-grid.title: Product Grid
product-grid.description: Products as cards in a grid, a list or a rail that scrolls sideways.

product-info.title: Product Info
product-info.description: Texts in an accordion beside a card of specs.

profile-form.title: Profile Form
profile-form.description: Account settings: picture, name, email, bio and notifications.

project-grid.title: Project Grid
project-grid.description: Projects as cards, a compact grid, captions over pictures, a bento or a list beside a collage.

proof-band.title: Proof Band
proof-band.description: A bar of customer logos and a row of key figures together.

quick-order.title: Quick Order
quick-order.description: Compact rows with a one-click order button and a phone field.

quote-split.title: Quote Split
quote-split.description: One quote beside a picture, a rating panel or over logo tiles; stacked quotes beside a picture; four compact quotes; figures over a featured quote and a stack.

recipe-kits.title: Recipe Kits
recipe-kits.description: Kits with the ingredients list, the cooking time and the portions.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Recipes (Tailwind classes per variant/size/state) of the composed primitives

reservation-form.title: Reservation Form
reservation-form.description: Book a table: name, phone, date, time, guests, optional notes and consent.

restaurant-menu.title: Restaurant Menu
restaurant-menu.description: Menu sections with dotted leaders to the price; no cart.

rich-text.title: Rich Text
rich-text.description: The body of the current page or post as rich text (headings, lists, quotes, pictures, code, tables) under its title and a meta line; in a reading column, wide, beside a side note, under a cover, in a card, or as the page heading over a wide cover.

shopping-cart.title: Shopping Cart
shopping-cart.description: The cart lines beside a summary with a promo code and a free-delivery bar.

sidebar-nav.title: Sidebar Nav
sidebar-nav.description: A vertical navigation with the brand on top and the user at the bottom: full, or icons only.

signup-wizard.title: Signup Wizard
signup-wizard.description: A sign-up in steps with a progress bar or a list of steps; back and next move between them.

site-header.title: Site Header
site-header.description: Skip link, brand, navigation, theme button and an optional call to action.

sitemap-footer.title: Sitemap Footer
sitemap-footer.description: A footer with the brand, groups of links and the copyright; a single row, a sign-up first or a status pill.

skeleton-layout.title: Skeleton Layout
skeleton-layout.description: Grey blocks in the shape of what is coming: cards, a list or an article.

slot-board.title: Slot Board
slot-board.description: Days with their delivery windows as radio chips, beside the zone card.

stats-band.title: Stats Band
stats-band.description: Key numbers as figures, cards or figures with icons.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: A multi-step form header with the current step.

steps-list.title: Steps List
steps-list.description: Numbered or icon steps in a row or a column.

store-hero.title: Store Hero
store-hero.description: The hero of a store with promises under the actions, beside a picture with an offer card or over a faint picture.

store-locations.title: Store Locations
store-locations.description: The stores with address, hours, phone and services.

story-tabs.title: Story Tabs
story-tabs.description: Year tabs over the panel of the chosen year, or the heading beside a picture with arrows and one dot per step. Choosing a step is an event.

support-channels.title: Support Channels
support-channels.description: Ways to get help: email, chat, docs.

sushi-sets.title: Sushi Sets
sushi-sets.description: A dense grid of sets with the piece count and the rolls of each.

team-grid.title: Team Grid
team-grid.description: The people of a team as cards, a minimal grid, detailed cards, rows beside a picture or a directory.

template-grid.title: Template Grid
template-grid.description: Template gallery: filters, a browse-all button and an 8-card MediaFrame grid.

testimonial-grid.title: Testimonial Grid
testimonial-grid.description: Customer quotes as cards or plain figures.

theme-base.description: Start values of a skin scoped on an element (data-skin on any element but <html>): the kit font, tracking, radius and shadows, so the element shows its own skin only. Licences of the skins in NOTICE.md.

theme-violet-bloom.description: Skin Violet Bloom: brand tokens (colours, radius, shadows, fonts) for every UI8Kit component, light and dark; on with data-skin="violet-bloom".

tour-callout.title: Tour Callout
tour-callout.description: One stop of a product tour: the explained element and a callout with the step, a sentence and buttons. Placing it on the real element is a port contract.

usage-calculator.title: Usage Calculator
usage-calculator.description: A slider for how much is used and the price it gives. The estimate follows the slider; the page keeps the value.

usp-strip.title: Usp Strip
usp-strip.description: Free delivery, returns, warranty and help in one band.

utils.title: Utils
utils.description: cn, variants, expr, safe URLs and the shared helpers of the primitives and compositions (plus the theme CSS in styles/)

veggie-box.title: Veggie Box
veggie-box.description: Fill a box by weight: produce tiles beside the box with a meter.

video-grid.title: Video Grid
video-grid.description: Customer videos as thumbnails with a play button. Playing is a port contract (VideoEmbed).

video-modal.title: Video Modal
video-modal.description: A dialog with a walkthrough video and an optional list of chapters. Opening and playing are port contracts.

week-menu.title: Week Menu
week-menu.description: Meal delivery as a week: one column per day with its meal.

zone-table.title: Zone Table
zone-table.description: Delivery zones and their prices as a table or as cards.

about-company.description: The culture of a company: a strip of three pictures, the heading, a few figures and the values. Axes: layout (split: the pictures beside the text, stacked: the pictures under it), tone, density.

about-me.description: A personal about section beside a portrait: a badge, the heading, a lead, then key facts and a list of specialities, or skill chips and expertise bars, and one or two links. Axes: layout (facts, skills), mediaSide, tone.

activity-feed.description: A panel with recent events: a timeline with dots on a line, or a list of rows with an icon. Axes: layout (timeline, list), density (default, compact), tone (default, muted).

announcement-bar.description: A thin strip above the page: an icon, one sentence, a link and an optional close button. Axes: tone (default, muted), layout (center, split), dismiss (show, hide).

app-shell.description: The frame of a signed-in app with a first screen in it. Axes: layout (sidebar: navigation on the left, top: a bar above the content, panes: a narrow navigation, a list and a detail), density. The collapse of the sidebar is a port contract.

article-body.description: A long read: sections with headings, text and an optional pull quote, in one reading column or beside a table of contents that links to each section. Axes: layout (column, toc), quotes (show, hide), tone. Highlighting the section being read is a port contract.

auth-card.description: A sign-in, sign-up or password reset card: heading, one sentence, the fields of the mode, a submit button, optional alternative sign-in buttons and a link to the other mode. Axes: mode (signin, signup, reset), layout (card, plain), social (none, show).

auth-layout.description: A whole sign-in page: the AuthCard placed in the page. Axes: layout (split: a picture panel beside the card, centered: the card on a tinted page, minimal: the card alone in a narrow column), side (end, start: the side of the picture), mode, social. The page's heading is the card's title.

before-after.description: Two columns that set life without the product against life with it, point by point. Axes: layout (cards: two cards, rows: one row per point), icons (show, hide), tone, density.

bento-grid.description: Tiles of different sizes in one grid: the large and wide tiles hold the important features. Sizes come from the data (large, wide, small). Axes: layout (bento, even: all tiles alike), media (none, image: a picture in the large tiles), tone, density.

bottom-nav.description: An app-style tab bar for a phone: an icon over a label per tab, the current one marked. Axes: labels (show, hide: icons only with the name hidden), position (static, sticky: stays at the bottom of the page), tone.

cart-drawer.description: The cart drawer in its open state, over a faded page: the head with a close button, the lines with a quantity field, the free-delivery bar, the totals and the button. The empty state shows an icon, a line and the way back. Static markup: opening and closing are the page's. Axes: state (filled, empty), media (image, none).

cart-list.description: The lines of a cart as a table or as cards: product, variant, price, quantity, line total and a remove button. Axes: layout (table, cards), media (image, none), density, tone.

category-nav.description: Navigation between product categories as chips, a bar with an underline, a side list, tiles with a big icon, or chips under a toolbar (search, sort and the number shown). The current one carries aria-current. Axes: layout (chips, bar, sidebar, tiles, toolbar), count (show, hide), icon (show, hide), density.

chart-panel.description: A panel with a chart of one series: vertical bars with captions, or meter rows with a percent. Axes: chart (bars, meters), size (default, compact), tone (default, muted).

checklist.description: An onboarding checklist: the tasks with a done mark, a progress bar or a count. Axes: layout (card, plain), progress (bar, text, none), marker (check, number), tone (default, muted).

checkout-form.description: A checkout on one page: contacts, address, a delivery window, the payment and the consent as stacked steps, beside a sticky order summary with the lines, a promo code and the totals. Static markup. Axes: layout (cards: each step in a card, numbered: numbered steps divided by a line), summary (aside, none), tone.

combo-builder.description: A set (combo) builder: three numbered steps, each a radio group of cards with the price (main, side, drink), beside or under a summary with the live total and the order button. Axes: layout (split, stacked), tone.

comparison-table.description: Plans, or a product and its competitors, as three columns and the features as rows. A value of yes shows a check, no a dash (both with a hidden word), anything else is shown as text. Axes: highlight (none, middle column), tone, density.

contact-form.description: A contact section: a form (name, email, subject, message, consent) and, in the split layout, the ways to reach us beside it. Axes: layout (single, split), fields (short: email and message, full), terms (show, hide), tone (default, muted).

cookie-banner.description: A consent notice: an icon, a heading, one paragraph and the buttons accept, decline and (optionally) settings. Axes: layout (bar, card), actions (two, three), tone (default, muted).

credit-packs.description: Packs of credits as tiles: the amount, a badge, the price and a buy button. Axes: columns (2, 4), item (tile, row), tone, density.

cta-band.description: A closing call to action: a heading, one sentence and one or two links. Axes: layout (card, band, split picture, row: heading beside the button in a card), tone, actions (one, two, form: an email field), proof (none, quote), density.

cta-banner.description: A centered closing card: heading, one sentence and a pill button. Sizes from the default preset.

cta-proof.description: A call to action with proof: a badge, the heading, a lead, the proof, one or two actions and an optional note. Axes: layout (center: everything centred, the proof above the actions; split: beside a picture), proof (logos, features, stats, rows, zones), mediaSide, tone.

dashboard-overview.description: The first screen of an app: counters, a chart and recent activity. Axes: layout (split: the chart and the activity side by side, stacked: one below the other), cols (2, 4), tone, density.

dashboard-shell.description: The frame of a signed-in app around placeholder content. Axes: topbar (full: across the whole shell, inset: over the content column only, none), search (show, hide: the search field of the top bar), sidebar (wide, rail, collapsed: the static collapsed state, twolevel: a rail and a section panel, none: the top bar carries the links), side (start, end), footer (full, inset, none), content (grid, split, list), frame (window: a framed window in a section, page: the whole page). Collapsing the sidebar is a port contract.

delivery-info.description: How delivery works: the facts as icon cards, then the zones with their time and the order that ships free. Axes: layout (full: facts over zone cards, facts: the facts only, split: the facts beside a list of zones), tone, density.

dish-bento.description: Featured dishes as a bento: the first dish in a large tile (two by two) with its summary and a link to its page, the others in small tiles around it. Axes: feature (start, end), tone.

dish-card.description: A dish as a card: picture, optional badge, category, name, portion/weight, summary, price and an order button. No rating. Axes: layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), density, action (button, none). Records map from Codex kind `dish`.

dish-cart-grid.description: Dishes added to the cart from the card: the live cart count over a grid of cards, each with a picture, name, weight, price and a quantity field named after the dish beside the add button. Axes: media (image, none), tone.

dish-compare.description: Grill cuts side by side: an accessible table (caption, column and row headers) of the cut, weight, cooking time, heat, marinade and price, or one compare card per cut with the same facts as a description list. Axes: layout (table, cards), tone.

dish-showcase.description: A showcase of dishes: each card is one link to the dish page (picture, badge, name, weight, summary, price and an arrow). No cart here. Axes: cols (3, 4), ratio (4/3, 1/1), tone.

dish-strip.description: A horizontal strip of dishes that scrolls sideways (a focusable, named region with snap points): small cards with a picture, name, weight, price and an add button. Axes: size (sm, lg), tone.

empty-panel.description: An empty list or an empty search: a round icon, a title, a hint and an optional action, in a card or plain. Axes: layout (card, plain), actions (button, none), size (default, compact).

error-page.description: A page that tells the visitor something went wrong: an icon or a big code, a heading, a sentence and the way back. Axes: layout (centered, split: the picture beside the text), code (show, hide), actions mode (one, two), tone.

faq-list.description: A section with a heading and the questions. Axes: layout (accordion: native disclosures that open without script; chat: question and answer as alternating bubbles), columns (1, 2), search mode (none, field: a search field above; the page filters by `search.query`), filter mode (none, categories: tabs above; the page filters by `filter.category`), density, tone.

faq-split.description: Questions in a split or as cards. Axes: layout (head: the heading and an action beside the disclosures, aside: the disclosures beside a help card, media: the disclosures and an action beside a picture, search: a finder beside a picture, cards: the questions as cards), cards (grid3, grid4, icons), mediaSide, tone.

feature-accordion.description: Features as a list of disclosures: icon and title in the summary, the text when open. Axes: expand (first: the first one is open, none: all closed), media (none, image: a picture beside the list), tone, density.

feature-grid.description: A section with a heading and the features as a grid of cards or tiles, or as rows with a picture. Icons are Lucide names. Axes: layout (grid, rows), columns, item (card, tile, cell: bordered tile with a round icon), media side (rows), density, tone.

feature-showcase.description: Features as cards under a centered heading. Axes: item (picture: a picture on top, then the title, the text and a read link; panel: a muted panel with a large glyph on top, then the title and the text), cols (3, 4), tone.

feature-split.description: Features beside a picture. Axes: layout (grid: four plain features in two columns, cards: four features as cards and the actions, stats: two figure cards over three checked rows beside a square picture, metrics: four metric cards and the actions), mediaSide, tone.

feature-sticky.description: A picture that stays in view while the feature descriptions scroll beside it. `active` marks the description that is current (the page follows the scroll; that is a port contract). Axes: mediaSide (end, start), item (plain, card), tone, density.

feature-tabs.description: Features behind a tab list: the chosen tab shows its text and a picture. The page keeps the chosen tab (`active`, empty for the first) and updates it on the `select` event. Axes: panel (split: text beside the picture, stack: picture below), tone, density.

footer-split.description: A footer with more than links. Axes: layout (stats: the brand with three figures and a sitemap link over the link groups as cards; points, links, newsletter, contacts, channels: a split beside a picture with the brand and four points, the brand and small link columns, a newsletter card and link columns, the contacts and two actions, or the community channels and figures), mediaSide, tone.

grill-builder.description: A grill (mangal) dish builder: the meat as picture cards in a radio group, the weight as chips, the sides as checkboxes with prices, then a summary with the live total and the order button. Axes: layout (split, stacked), tone.

grocery-list.description: Groceries as a compact list: a small square picture (or none), the name, the pack size, the price and an add button, in one or two columns. Axes: thumbs (show, hide), cols (1, 2), tone.

hero-classic.description: The top of a page: heading, lead and actions, with optional media (image, backdrop, code window, cluster). Axes: layout, media kind and side, scale, tone, density, actions mode.

hero-prompt.description: A dark hero band: the head row, a badge, a title with weighted words, the prompt box (or actions) and topic pills.

hero-split.description: A split hero: a badge, the heading, a lead, an extra under it and one or two actions, beside the media. Axes: extra (stats: three figures, avatars: faces and a proof line, minis: two small feature cards, quote: a quote over three figures, none), media (picture, card: a floating card on the picture, grid: four pictures with captions, plans: two plan cards on the picture), mediaSide, tone.

icon-wall.description: A dense grid of small tiles: an icon and a short label. Axes: columns (3, 4, 6), item (tile: icon above the label, chip: icon beside it), tone, density.

job-board.description: Open jobs as cards in two columns, grouped by department, or as a table: the title, the department, the place, the type, an optional salary and an apply link. Axes: layout (grid, grouped, table), salary (show, hide), tone.

kanban-board.description: Work items in lanes. Each lane has a title, a count and its cards; a card has a title, an optional tag and the person it belongs to. Axes: card (simple, detail: tag and person), cols (2, 3), tone, density. Moving a card between lanes is a port contract.

lightbox-gallery.description: Photos in a grid, a masonry of mixed heights, or a featured picture over thumbnails, with a dialog that shows the selected photo. Static markup: the dialog open state is a prop. Axes: layout (grid, masonry, featured), captions (show, hide), lightbox (open, closed).

logo-cloud.description: A heading and the names of customers or partners as Lucide glyphs with a name. Axes: layout (grid, row), columns (2, 3, 4), item (name, icon only, tile), density, tone.

logo-ribbon.description: A heading over one centered row of logo slots (LogoSlot); the row and slot sizes come from the default preset.

media-list.description: A list or figures beside a picture. Axes: layout (figures: four figures in two columns, proof: three figures and a featured review, steps: numbered steps, posts: the latest posts, topics: topic rows with counts, contact: contact buttons and support figures), mediaSide, tone. The actions follow every layout but contact.

mega-menu.description: A top bar whose first item opens a wide panel of link groups, each with an icon and a list, and an optional promo card. The page keeps `open`; opening on hover or click is a port contract. Axes: panel (open, closed), cols (2, 3), promo (none, card).

menu-board.description: A restaurant menu board: category sections with DishCards in a grid, or denser menu rows in a list or a sectioned column. Axes: layout (sections, grid, list), prices (show, hide), density. Composes DishCard; section rows use MenuRow.

metric-row.description: Dashboard counters in a row or a grid: tiles with an icon, a number and a caption, or compact figures. Axes: columns (2, 4), item (tile, compact), tone (default, muted), density (default, compact).

milestone-timeline.description: Milestones on a line: the year, a tag, a title and a sentence each. Axes: layout (split: a vertical line beside a picture, stacked: a vertical line in a narrow column, row: a horizontal line of columns), tone, density.

nav-bar.description: A top bar in four shapes. Axes: layout (inline: brand left, links, button right; split: the brand in the middle with the links on both sides; search: a search field with its shortcut in the middle), over (none, media: the bar sits over a picture, transparent), actions mode (none, cta), tone (default, inverse: on a dark hero band). Turning solid on scroll is a port contract.

newsletter-form.description: An email sign-up: heading, one sentence, an email field and a button, with an optional consent line and picture. Axes: layout (inline, stacked, split), terms (show, hide), tone (default, muted), align (start, center).

order-summary.description: The totals of an order: subtotal, shipping, tax and the total, with a checkout button and a note. Axes: layout (card, plain), cta (show, hide), note (show, hide), density, tone.

order-table.description: The order history as a table or as cards: number, date, items, total and a status pill, with an optional pager. Axes: layout (table, cards), pager (show, hide), tone, density.

page-intro.description: The head of an inner page: the heading (h1 on a page of its own), one sentence and, optionally, an action. Axes: align (start, center), tone, density.

page-trail.description: The head of an inner page with breadcrumbs. Axes: aside (none, figure: one large figure such as a count or a total, note: a small card with a glyph such as a delivery promise or a document version, facts: four key facts in two columns), tone.

photo-gallery.description: Photos in a grid, a masonry of mixed heights, a mosaic with one big tile, a featured picture over a strip of thumbnails, or cards with a title and a tag. Static markup: the featured layout's arrows are the page's. Axes: layout (grid, masonry, mosaic, featured, cards), captions (show, hide), tone, density.

pizza-picker.description: Pizzas with a picker on each card: the picture, name and toppings, a radio group of sizes and one of crusts (each a fieldset with role radiogroup), the price and an add button. Axes: layout (cards, rows), tone.

post-card.description: A post as a card: cover picture, category, title, excerpt, author line and a read link. Axes: layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), meta (full, short: the date only, news: date and title only), density.

post-grid.description: A section with a heading and the posts as cards: a grid, a list of horizontal cards, or a magazine (the first post wide, the rest in a grid). Axes: layout (grid, list, magazine), columns, media, meta (full, short, news), filter mode (none, topics), pager (none, pages), tone, density.

post-header.description: The top of a post page: category, title, excerpt, the author line and an optional wide cover. Axes: layout (start, center), cover (show, hide), meta (full, short), tone.

post-showcase.description: Posts shown off. Axes: layout (intro: four small post cards beside the intro with a view-all link, featured: the first post in detail beside its picture, overlay: cards with the text over the picture), cols (2, 3: overlay columns), mediaSide, tone.

post-split.description: A post header with the author, the reading figures, the tags and the actions. Axes: layout (center: tags, figures and an author card with share and save over a wide cover; split: beside the cover; outline: facts and related reading beside the cover), mediaSide, author (line, card, bio), cover (wide, square), actions (pair, wide, icons), tone.

pricing-card.description: A plan as a card: name, tagline, price per month, the features, a call to action and an optional slot for more actions. Text comes in through `labels`; the plan is data.

pricing-tiers.description: A section with a heading and one PricingCard per plan; an empty state when there are none. Axes: layout (grid, stack), columns, emphasis, billing (off: no toggle; monthly or annual: a toggle with that choice selected, and the prices of that period), density, tone.

product-card.description: A product as a card: picture, optional badge, category, name, rating, summary, price (and the old price struck through when `compareAt` is higher) and an add button. Axes: layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), ratio, rating (show, hide), action (button, none), density.

product-detail.description: A product page: a gallery (the main picture and optional thumbnails) beside the buy box (badge, rating, price, stock, quantity, add button, shipping and returns notes). Axes: layout (split, stacked), media side, thumbs (none, below), buy (full, compact), tone, density.

product-grid.description: A section with a heading and the products as cards in a grid, as a list of horizontal cards, or as a rail that scrolls sideways; an empty state when there are none. Axes: layout (grid, list, rail), columns, ratio, rating, action, tone, density.

product-info.description: The details of a product under its buy box: texts in an accordion (native details) beside a card with the specs. Axes: layout (split: the specs beside the texts, stacked: below them), expand (first: the first text open, none), tone.

profile-form.description: An account settings form: a picture with a change button, name, email, bio and two notification switches, with save and cancel. Axes: layout (stacked, split), avatar (show, hide), prefs (show, hide), tone (default, muted).

project-grid.description: Projects of a studio or a person: cards with tags and links, a compact grid, tiles with the caption over the picture, a bento with one big project, or a list beside a collage. Axes: layout (cards, compact, overlay, bento, list), tone, density.

proof-band.description: Customer logos together with the key numbers: logos above the numbers, or beside them. Axes: layout (above, beside), logos (name, icon), tone, density.

quick-order.description: Quick order in one click: compact rows (name, weight, summary, price) each with an order button named after the dish, under a phone field that the one click uses. Axes: phone (show, hide), tone.

quote-split.description: Testimonials in a split or with figures. Axes: layout (media: one quote card and an action beside a picture, logos: one quote over four logo tiles beside a picture, rating: one quote beside a rating panel, stack: three stacked quote cards beside a picture, compact: four short quote cards in a row, bento: figures over a featured quote beside a stack), mediaSide, tone.

recipe-kits.description: Recipe kits delivered home: a picture beside the kit name, cooking time, the ingredients list, a portions radio group and the price with an add button. Axes: layout (rows, cards), tone.

reservation-form.description: A table reservation: name, phone and/or email, date, time, guests, optional notes and consent; in the split layout, the ways to reach the house sit beside the form. Axes: layout (single, split), density, fields (full, compact).

restaurant-menu.description: A restaurant menu by sections: a nav of section links, then each section (heading and note) with its dishes as menu lines (name, a dotted leader, the price; the summary and weight below). No cart. Axes: cols (1, 2), tone.

review-list.description: Customer reviews as cards or plain entries: rating, title, text, author and date. Axes: layout (list, grid), columns, item (card, plain), avatar (none, image), tone, density.

rich-text.description: Rich text: the body of the current page or post (trusted markup from the content source) styled by Prose, under its title and a meta line (date, author, category). Axes: layout (narrow: one reading column; wide: a wider column; sidebar: the body and a side note; media: a cover above the body; card: the body in a card; hero: the title as the page heading over a wide cover), tone, density.

shopping-cart.description: The cart as a page: the lines as cards (picture, name, variant, price, quantity, line total, remove) with the way back, beside the order summary with a promo code and the free-delivery bar. Static markup. Axes: layout (split: the summary beside the lines, stacked: below them), promo (show, hide), progress (show, hide), tone.

sidebar-nav.description: A vertical navigation: the brand at the top, the links stacked, the user at the bottom. Axes: width (full: icon and name, compact: icons only with the name hidden), user (show, hide), density.

signup-wizard.description: A sign-up in steps: the progress, the fields of the current step, back and next. `current` is the step shown, counted from 1. Axes: progress (bar, list: every step named), layout (card, plain). Keeping the typed values between steps is the page's job.

site-footer.description: The page footer: the copyright line and the same two links. Axes: layout (minimal, centered), density (default, compact).

site-header.description: The page header: a skip link to the main content, the brand, the two navigation links (the current one carries aria-current) and the theme button. `current` is the route area. Axes: layout (inline, stacked), position (static, sticky), actions (none, cta).

sitemap-footer.description: A footer with the brand, a tagline, groups of links and the copyright. Axes: layout (columns: brand above, equal columns per group, row: the brand, the group names and the copyright in one row), signup mode (none, first: a sign-up above the links), status mode (none, show: a live status pill), density. The live status itself is a port contract.

skeleton-layout.description: The loading state of a page: grey blocks in the shape of the content that is coming (cards, a list of rows or an article). Axes: shape (cards, list, article), tone. The label tells assistive technology that the content is loading. The shimmer itself belongs to the Skeleton part.

slot-board.description: Pick a delivery window: the days with their windows as radio chips, beside a card with the zone, its price and the buttons. Static markup. Axes: layout (split: the card beside the days, stacked: the days only), item (card, plain), tone.

stats-band.description: Key numbers in a row or grid: plain figures, cards (StatTile) or figures with an icon. Axes: columns (2, 3, 4), item (plain, card, icon), surface (none, image, panel: one rounded card), align, density, tone. Title may be empty.

stepper.description: A multi-step form header: the steps with the current one marked (aria-current step), and the current step's text with back and next buttons. Axes: layout (horizontal, vertical), marker (number, icon), summary (show, hide).

steps-list.description: How it works: numbered or icon steps in a row or a column. Axes: layout (row, column), marker (number, icon), align, density, tone.

store-hero.description: The hero of a store: a badge, the heading, a lead, one or two actions and three store promises. The overlay layout puts a picture beside the text with an offer card floating on it; the backdrop layout puts the text over a faint picture. Axes: layout (overlay, backdrop), mediaSide, tone.

store-locations.description: The stores of a shop: name, a badge of its kind (pickup or store only), address, hours, phone, a note and the services. Axes: layout (cards, list: one row per store, map: compact cards beside a map picture), tone.

story-tabs.description: A story in steps (years or slides). Axes: layout (years: a row of year tabs over the panel of the active year with its badge, step, title, text and tag; carousel: the heading beside a picture with previous and next arrows and one dot per step), tone. Choosing a step emits `select`.

support-channels.description: Ways to get help as cards or rows, each with an icon, a title, a sentence and an open link. Axes: layout (grid, list), columns, action (link, none), tone (default, muted).

sushi-sets.description: Sushi sets as a dense grid of tiles: a square picture with the piece count over it, the name, the rolls of the set as a list, the price and an add button. Axes: cols (3, 4), tone.

team-grid.description: The people of a team: portrait cards, a minimal grid of small portraits, detailed cards with skills, rows beside a picture, or a directory of two columns. Axes: layout (cards, minimal, detailed, list, directory), cols, tone, density.

template-grid.description: Template gallery: a heading, outline filter pills, a grid of template cards and a full-width browse-all button.

testimonial-grid.description: Customer quotes as cards, plain figures or social posts, in a grid, a masonry, a scroll strip, one featured quote or one narrow column. Axes: layout (grid, single, stack, masonry, strip), columns, item kind (card, plain, social), item avatar, item rating, item mark (a company glyph), density, tone. A carousel is the Carousel port contract around the single layout.

tour-callout.description: One stop of a product tour: the element being explained and a callout beside it with a title, a sentence, the position in the tour and the buttons. Axes: placement (below, above, end: the callout sits beside the target), tone, density.

usage-calculator.description: A price that follows a slider: the chosen amount of use, the price per unit and the estimate. The page keeps the amount and updates it on the `usage` event. Axes: layout (card, plain), ends (show: the smallest and the largest amount under the slider, hide), tone.

usp-strip.description: The promises of a store in one band: free delivery, returns, warranty, help. Axes: layout (strip: one muted panel, cards: a card each, bar: a thin line of icons and titles), tone, density.

veggie-box.description: A vegetable box by weight: produce tiles (picture, name, price per kg, a weight field in kg named after the item) beside the box card with a meter of how full the box is, the total and the order button. Axes: layout (split, stacked), tone.

video-grid.description: Video testimonials as thumbnails: a picture, a play button, the name and the company. The player is a port contract (VideoEmbed); here the button emits `play`. Axes: columns (2, 3), caption (below, overlay), tone, density.

video-modal.description: A dialog with a walkthrough video: a title and a close button, the player area with a play button and, optionally, a list of chapters. Opening the dialog and playing the video are port contracts. Axes: size (default, wide), outline (none, chapters: a list under the player), tone.

week-menu.description: Meal delivery as a week: one column per day (its name and delivery note) with the meal of that day as a small card (picture, name, weight, price). Axes: media (image, none), tone.

zone-table.description: Delivery zones and their prices as a table or as cards: the zone and its areas, the price, the order that ships free, the minimum order, the time and an express badge. Axes: layout (table, cards), tone, density.
